basic_info.description: Spectacular, completely rebuilt triplex on 4 levels, with all new plumbing, electrical, foundation, I-beam steel framing, sprinkler system and roof. Detached on three sides, with gorgeous wide plank white oak floors and a stunning open kitchen-living-dining floorplans. Chef's kitchens with Thermador stainless appliances, warm wood cabinetry and beautiful Concreto counters. Incredibe entertaining spaces with half baths. Elegant and full-size bedrooms all have ensuite baths, and every unit has an additional home office. A large exclusive use patio goes with the lower unit and a view deck with the PH. Soaring 11' ceilings in two of the units. Washer-dryers and huge 3 car garage with room for storage. In a great location adjacent to NOPA, the Haight and the Divisadero commercial area, this building is not to be missed.
